summary: Frontend-only timezone fix validated on /ativacoes-selfservice. Seeded 3 activations (naive datetime 2026-08-16T01:21:00 UTC, aware UTC same, regression 2026-07-10T14:00Z) with browser context timezone=UTC. All rendered dates matched expected BRT values.

minor.issue: created_at serialized WITHOUT trailing 'Z' when stored as naive datetime (e.g. '2026-08-16T01:21:00'). Frontend now compensates, but backend should ideally always store/serialize as timezone-aware UTC with 'Z' suffix to avoid similar bugs elsewhere.

action_items: (Optional hardening) Update backend to always serialize created_at as UTC-aware ISO with 'Z' suffix so other pages/components don't need the same client-side workaround.
critical_code_review_comments: AtivacoesSelfService.jsx L300-314: fix is correct (checks Z or +/-HH:MM offset before appending Z, uses timeZone America/Sao_Paulo in toLocale*). Consider extracting to a shared util (e.g., formatBRDateTime) since other list pages likely have the same bug.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 3 TEST_TZ_* docs in ativacoes_selfservice for validation, cleaned up after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Timezone fix confirmed. Verified matrix: (a) naive '2026-08-16T01:21:00' -> 15/08/2026 22:21 BRT; (b) aware UTC same instant -> 15/08/2026 22:21 BRT; (c) regression '2026-07-10T14:00Z' -> 10/07/2026 11:00 BRT. Playwright browser timezone was UTC (verified via Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone) so timeZone option on toLocale* is doing the conversion, not host tz.
rca of the issue: Backend salva created_at como datetime UTC no Mongo. FastAPI/Pydantic serializa datetime naive como ISO sem 'Z'. JS new Date() sem sufixo interpreta como horario LOCAL do browser, deslocando +3h em containers UTC. Fix aplicado no frontend anexa 'Z' quando ausente e forca timeZone 'America/Sao_Paulo' no toLocaleDateString/TimeString. Validado que datas antigas nao regridem.
